seo.title: Recgon — The AI Product Manager for small teams
seo.h1: Recgon — The AI Product Manager for small teams
seo.intro: One brain for the whole team. Recgon reads your codebase, GA4 analytics, and team activity, then decides what to ship next and assigns each task to the best-fit teammate by skill match and calendar availability.

what.item1: Reads your GitHub codebase and produces stage, SWOT, top risks, growth levers, and a ranked next-step list per project
what.item2: Ingests GA4 analytics and summarizes traffic, channels, and funnel signals
what.item3: Mints tasks from this unified signal (next_step, dev_prompt, marketing, analytics, research)
what.item4: Auto-assigns each task to the best-fit teammate using skill scores and calendar availability
what.item5: Verifies completed work against acceptance criteria
what.item6: Surfaces a daily cockpit: today's focus, decision deck, team pulse, and what shipped

how.step1: Connect a GitHub repo, a GA4 property, and your teammates
how.step2: Recgon analyzes and produces a running product snapshot
how.step3: Tasks land on the right teammate's calendar; you see what to ship today

seo.who: Small teams (2-10) with a founder running product. Indie hackers, early-stage startups, and side-project teams that need a PM's strategic loop and a project manager's assignment discipline — without the headcount.

q1.a: Recgon is an AI Product Manager for small teams. It reads your codebase, GA4 analytics, and team activity, then surfaces what to ship next and automatically assigns each task to the best-fit teammate by skill and calendar.

q2.a: Connect a GitHub repo and a GA4 property. Recgon ingests the code and the traffic, builds a running snapshot of your product (stage, SWOT, top risks, growth levers, prioritized next steps), and refreshes it whenever new commits land.

q3.a: Each task is scored against every active teammate by skill match, current workload, and open time on their calendar. The best fit gets assigned and pinged. If no teammate scores above the minimum fit threshold, the task is left unassigned for you to triage.

q4.q: Does Recgon do the work itself?
q4.a: No. Recgon assigns work to humans. It plans, prioritizes, schedules, and verifies — your team ships.

q5.q: Is there a Claude Code integration?
q5.a: Yes. Recgon ships an MCP server so Claude Code can read your product analysis, pick up an actionable next step, implement it, and mark it complete — all tracked back in Recgon.
